overview: The committee approved the city council newsletter draft covering February through April and reviewed a draft strategy for hosting sixteen neighborhood ward meetings over the next two years.

items.title: City Council Newsletter
items.summary: Approved the combined February, March, and April newsletter draft with additions regarding budget priorities, the vacant property ordinance, and election commission equipment.

items.title: Neighborhood Ward Meetings Strategy
items.summary: Reviewed a rollout plan for sixteen ward-based meetings, discussing logistical challenges including hybrid technology requirements, location accessibility in underserved areas, and councilor co-facilitation.
